newsitem.title: UK: Blenheim tumbles after takeover talks end.
newsitem.headline: Blenheim tumbles after takeover talks end.

text.p: Shares in Blenheim Group plunged by almost 14 percent after the company on Friday said takeover talks were terminated, ending weeks of market speculation.
By 0759 GMT, the shares were down 55-1/2p to 342-1/2p.
The company said on Friday, "Blenheim has not received proposals which its board believes should be recommended to shareholders. Blenheim announces that such talks have now been terminated."
Talks between Blenheim and United News & Media were thought to have taken place through the summer. Reed Elsevier also was thought to be talking to Blenheim. Both declined to comment.
Market makers said Blenheim's shares are fairly valued between 340p and 350p in the absence of a bid. "But the company is still vulnerable to a hostile takeover," added one.
